posts.subject: 100hp maps?
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear dream community,

Ka_Dreamy_Jumps (100hp)
ka_pool (mixture of 100,35 and 1 hp) ( Thank you @Doo Doo 🙂 )
35hp_skatepark (1hp)
35hp_auto_anger (zeus on the map)

Dreamy Jumps is still in the active map pool? Hm, I thought that map was removed.


Regardless, I'll try to edit the maps so we can get 35HP versions of those.
Also, regarding the 35hp_Iraq map, midway through the map, it always causes the server to crash so maybe we can remove the map or seek to resolve the problem?
